brief: MoneyPrinter-only proof render for Monday, August 24, 2026. Use current-news B-roll, August Nick ElevenLabs narration, large readable captions, and a modern 9:16 pace. Do not fall back to Remotion.

moneyprinter.video_script: Here's your Monday news brief so far. The U.S. threatened 50 percent tariffs on Canadian cars and trucks beginning January first after trade talks broke down. Washington also broadened its sanctions threat against countries doing business with Iran, raising pressure on global trade and oil flows. In tech, Alibaba launched Wan 3.0, its newest AI video model, after a major share sale to fund AI. And China's record auto recall is hitting about 4.3 million vehicles, including nearly 3 million Teslas. That's the fast brief.
